agents-exe: a command-line LLM-agent tool. An agent is a JSON file (endpoint, model, system prompt, command-line tools, MCP servers, helper agents); it runs one-shot, in a terminal UI, as an MCP server, or behind an HTTP server with durable sessions.

Overview: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/
Getting started: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/getting-started.html
Command reference: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/commands.html
Architecture: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/docs-architecture.html
Tools: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/docs-tools.html
Parameters, bindings and narrowing: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/docs-parameters-and-bindings.html
agents-server (HTTP): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/docs-agents-server.html
Docs index: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/docs.html
Specs index (design documents, each with a Status line): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/agents-exe/specs.html

Canonical sources, on GitHub:
- Repository: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/agents-exe
